This pivotal role involves leading the strategic planning, execution, and oversight of all company events, encompassing both internal and external engagements. You will be responsible for creating memorable experiences that enhance our brand presence and foster strong relationships with stakeholders.

In this role, you will manage event budgets, timelines, and vendor relationships, collaborating closely with marketing, sales, and other internal teams to ensure seamless integration and promotion. You will oversee all event logistics, from venue selection and catering to registration and on-site management. We are looking for a leader who can analyze event performance, provide insightful reports, and continuously drive improvements based on industry best practices.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality Management, or a related field
8+ years of progressive experience in event management
At least 3 years of experience in a leadership role within event management
Proven ability to manage complex projects and multiple events simultaneously
Strong negotiation and vendor management skills
finalJson.salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary based on experience, comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth.

finalJson.description: We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Team Leader to join our customer service center in Orlando, FL. In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for guiding and inspiring a team of customer service representatives, ensuring the delivery of exceptional service and the achievement of key performance targets. This is an excellent opportunity for a leader passionate about fostering team growth and driving operational excellence.As a Team Leader, you will oversee daily operations, conduct regular coaching sessions, and monitor team performance against critical metrics such as call quality and customer satisfaction. You will be the go-to person for escalated customer inquiries, ensuring swift and effective resolution, and will play a key role in identifying training needs and implementing process improvements to enhance the overall customer experience.This full-time position offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan. Join a supportive environment that values professional development and provides ample opportunities for career advancement.
requirements: 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
At least 1 year of experience in a supervisory or team lead capacity
Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop a team
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and CRM software
finalJson.salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary with comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, paid time off, and 401(k) retirement plan. Compensation based on experience.

finalJson.description: Join a dynamic legal team as a Director, Legal (Senior Counsel) in a fully remote capacity. This pivotal role involves providing comprehensive legal advice and support across a spectrum of corporate and commercial matters, ensuring the organization's operations align with legal standards and best practices. You will be instrumental in managing legal risks and contributing to strategic initiatives.The successful candidate will be responsible for drafting, reviewing, and negotiating diverse commercial contracts, offering expert guidance on corporate governance, intellectual property, and data privacy. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with various internal stakeholders and play a key role in maintaining legal compliance and supporting business growth.
requirements: Juris Doctor (JD) degree from an accredited law school
Active bar membership in at least one U.S. state
7+ years of experience practicing law, with significant in-house or top-tier law firm experience
Strong experience in commercial contracts, corporate law, and data privacy
